info.name: IMS — Reports (Excel)
info.description: Supply and transfer reports. Every request downloads an .xlsx file with all rows; there is no JSON response on success. Use **Send and Download** to save the file. All requests need a bearer token: set base_url and token, and optionally store_id, date_from and date_to (Y-m-d; empty dates mean the current month). Validation errors return JSON 422 with only the first error.

query.description: Receiving store ID. Leave empty for all stores.
Start date, Y-m-d. Defaults to the first day of the current month.
End date, Y-m-d. Defaults to today. Must be on or after date_from.

request.description:
Supplier POs (POType 0/1) created in the date range. One row per item; the order fields repeat on each item row. Diff Qty = received - ordered.

Downloads an .xlsx file with every row (no pagination). In Postman use **Send and Download** to save it.

Columns: Item Lookup Code, Description, Supplier, Store, Rcv Date, Create Date, Po Number, Qty Order, Qty Rcv, Supplier Cost, Diff Qty
